# Engineering map

<!-- Generated by npm run map:generate; edit docs/engineering-map.json and scripts/engineering-map/generate.mjs. -->

Use the matching area below to find the owner, then read its linked product contract
before editing. [PRODUCT_SPEC.md](../PRODUCT_SPEC.md) and its linked specifications
remain authoritative. This is a routing guide, not another behavior specification
or an exhaustive source inventory. Owner paths are implementation entry points;
only the package imports listed at the end are cross-package consumer interfaces.
Web-local exports listed below are seams within the web application.

## Keeping the map current

In the same change that moves ownership, renames a mapped module/export, changes a
boundary or invariant, or replaces a verification command, review the affected
area in [engineering-map.json](engineering-map.json), update the authoritative
product spec when behavior changes, and run `npm run map:generate`.
Review adjacent areas when splitting a controller or moving responsibilities.
Run `npm run verify:map` before committing; it is also part of `verify:fast`.

The check validates mapped paths, TypeScript exports (including re-exports), npm
script names and their local Node script targets, package export targets, and exact
generated output. It does **not** prove that ownership descriptions or invariant
prose remain semantically current, that the selected checks are sufficient, or
that those checks pass. A still-existing module can stop owning a responsibility;
architecture review must catch that even when freshness validation passes.

## Area routes

Run `npm run verify:fast` for all changes and `npm run verify` for shared product
changes. The area checks below add focused evidence; invoke each with `npm run`.
Read the delivery contract for prerequisites and evidence flags; `home:evidence`
needs a running preview, and panel builds normally require a committed tree.

### Scene geometry and rendering

Contract: [Scene geometry and rendering](../docs/product/geometry-and-rendering.md).

- Owners: [`packages/engine/src/ArchitectureScene.tsx`](../packages/engine/src/ArchitectureScene.tsx), [`packages/engine/src/architecture-scene`](../packages/engine/src/architecture-scene), [`packages/engine/src/rendering.tsx`](../packages/engine/src/rendering.tsx), [`packages/engine/src/HomeAssistantSceneLighting.tsx`](../packages/engine/src/HomeAssistantSceneLighting.tsx), [`packages/engine/src/building`](../packages/engine/src/building), [`packages/engine/src/stairs`](../packages/engine/src/stairs), [`packages/engine/src/SceneLighting.tsx`](../packages/engine/src/SceneLighting.tsx), [`packages/engine/src/lighting.ts`](../packages/engine/src/lighting.ts), [`packages/engine/src/solar-shadow-frame.ts`](../packages/engine/src/solar-shadow-frame.ts), [`packages/engine/src/hedges`](../packages/engine/src/hedges), [`packages/engine/src/boundaries`](../packages/engine/src/boundaries), [`packages/engine/src/floor-finishes`](../packages/engine/src/floor-finishes), [`packages/engine/src/architecture-geometry/wall-face-finish.ts`](../packages/engine/src/architecture-geometry/wall-face-finish.ts), [`packages/engine/src/architecture-geometry/wall-cap-finishes.ts`](../packages/engine/src/architecture-geometry/wall-cap-finishes.ts), [`packages/engine/src/wall-colors.ts`](../packages/engine/src/wall-colors.ts), [`packages/engine/src/floor-finishes/wood-planks.ts`](../packages/engine/src/floor-finishes/wood-planks.ts).
- Interface: `ArchitectureScene`, `StylizedScene`, `deriveSolarLighting`, `resolveSolarLighting`, `DEFAULT_WALL_COLORS` via [`packages/engine/src/index.ts`](../packages/engine/src/index.ts).
- Review invariant: Trace derived geometry and collision from floor architecture; native geometry uses procedural toon rendering; personal GLBs preserve materials through their dedicated import owner. Active-floor emitters retain zero-intensity lights across state changes to avoid shader recompilation. Room emphasis updates floor materials and wall vertex colors without rebuilding geometry or changing device lights. Solar direction follows geographic north; one resolved source drives Auto lighting and its label, with building-sized solar shadows and unshadowed luminaires. Interior right-angle endpoint corners share a filled footprint across batched and standalone geometry. Architectural planes retain exact geometry during LOD selection. Orbit wall cutaways retain cast shadows during opacity transitions. Boundary styles retain the hedges wire format and continuous segment collision, including open fences. Floor preset colors are portable optional hex values; procedural tile patterns retain neutral grout. Standalone and batched wall caps and opening reveals share edge-finish precedence; shared horizontal junction surfaces retain the general finish when owners disagree. Horizontal caps are partitioned by finish before triangulation to prevent color bleeding across adjacent walls. DEFAULT_WALL_COLORS is the single source of production wall palette defaults; authored finishes take precedence. Interior Auto edges ignore stale exterior paint metadata. Dark walnut and both light-oak directions use deterministic fine grain and staggered boards in an engine-owned repeating canvas texture.
- Checks: `test:unit`, `verify:policy`, `verify:scene-contours`, `fixture:verify:scale`, `measure:scene`.
